defects.defect: The run asked the user whether to fill only when blank or to overwrite, and create-only vs create+update. Fill-when-blank on create and update, never overwriting, was a clear, safe default (the spec itself marked it recommended). The question was unnecessary; expect.should_ask_user was false.
defects.skill_gap: Partial: SKILL.md says to decide implementation choices that have a clear default, but does not explicitly list 'overwrite vs fill-when-blank for a derived field' as an implementation default.
